name: Nanase Mizuka
source:
A member of the idol group HINAMEL.
Blessed with a striking figure, she knows exactly how to carry herself to catch the eye of the opposite sex.
Openly expressive and always eager to entertain, she has a natural instinct for giving fans what they want.
But she can also be laid-back to a fault—for better or worse—and has a habit of arriving on set with only moments to spare before she would actually be late.

[From in-game tips]
